result.summary: The home screen is mostly well-formed. One clear defect: the 'Tokumaru Ramen' restaurant title is truncated or rendered incorrectly, with the last letter showing as a glyph that looks like 'ı'. This is not a carousel edge, so it is a real defect. There are also a few minor contrast and styling concerns.

issues.description: The restaurant name in the 'Popular right now' card reads 'Tokumaru Ramei' or 'Ramen' with a clipped final character. The last letter is cut off or misrendered, even though there is plenty of free space in the row. It looks like a text-clipping or font rendering bug.
issues.suggestion: Check the text container width, padding, and overflow settings, and the font glyph and line-height handling. Make sure the full name 'Tokumaru Ramen' renders, or use proper ellipsis truncation if it is too long.

issues.description: The secondary gray text (delivery fees, 'min' details, inactive nav labels) and the white-on-image time pills have relatively low contrast. The light green promo subtext on the green banner is also fairly weak.
issues.suggestion: Darken the gray text and the inactive nav labels, and make the promo subtext whiter, to meet WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast.

issues.description: The heart favorite button on the pizza card sits on a dark translucent circle while the ramen card's button has a different, nearly invisible background, so the two look inconsistent. The '−20%' badge also looks slightly different from the other badges.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent style for the favorite buttons and badges across cards, with enough contrast against the image.
